description: DIBCO-ONLY BASELINE VALIDATION. Direct restoration training from scratch (NO pretrained, NO Base/ANRI). Purpose: Validate if DIBCO target 28-30 dB is achievable at all. Strategy: (1) Train ONLY on DIBCO dataset (461 samples with palm), (2) NO transfer learning (clean slate), (3) Restoration-optimized loss weights (Pixel 200, Perceptual 50), (4) Discriminator mode 'clean' (discriminate clean images), (5) Longer training (50 epochs, patience 10), (6) Single validation (DIBCO only, no Base/ANRI complexity). If successful (≥28 dB): Progressive finetuning wrong, use separate models. If failed (<20 dB): Dataset quality or architecture issue.

experiment_metadata.purpose: Validate if DIBCO 28-30 dB target is achievable

dataset_composition.note: DIBCO ONLY - no synthetic or ANRI data

strategy.training_from_scratch: YES - no pretrained checkpoint, clean slate

loss_weights.rationale: Restoration task needs strong pixel + perceptual guidance, unlike generation

strategy.discriminator_mode: ground_truth (discriminate clean ground truth images for restoration)
strategy.validation: Single validation (DIBCO only, no Base/ANRI complexity)

interpretation.if_success: Progressive finetuning was wrong approach, use separate DIBCO-only model
interpretation.if_marginal: 20-25 dB = Dataset quality issue or need architecture tuning
interpretation.if_failure: <20 dB = Fundamental architecture or dataset problem

expected_outcome.dibco_psnr: 26-30 dB (optimistic estimate based on architecture capability)
expected_outcome.best_epoch: 15-25 (restoration typically needs more epochs than generation)
expected_outcome.note: If DIBCO-only achieves 28+ dB, proves progressive finetuning unnecessary for DIBCO

rehearsal_v1.result: FAILED - catastrophic forgetting prevented but DIBCO stuck at 15 dB

v4_no_rehearsal.result: EMERGENCY STOP - catastrophic ANRI forgetting (29.65 dB)

experiment_metadata.hypothesis: DIBCO restoration task fundamentally different from Base/ANRI generation. Transfer learning from generation → restoration may hurt performance. Direct restoration training should achieve better results.

if_dibco_only_succeeds: Use separate models: Base/ANRI generator + DIBCO restoration model
if_dibco_only_fails: Investigate DIBCO dataset quality (corrupted samples, incorrect labels)
Consider GAN instability or loss function issues
Evaluate if DIBCO benchmark images actually restorable to 28-30 dB
